about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-59, part of the 'cover ALL' decomposition (XC-54 to XC-78) drafted on 2026-10-25 from public sources. Nothing here is binding and vv does not read this file. It becomes part of the contract only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub. Every criterion except scope, pushed and the unchanged-suite guards fails on the v1.6.0 tree. Evidence is testnet-only, loopback-only and verify-only unless the task says otherwise; hosted facilitators are never called. Estimated effort: 4-6 days.

not_contract_tasks.keys: Throwaway testnet keys and faucet tokens are created on the owner's machine and live in X402C_KEYS outside the repository. No spend, no mainnet.
not_contract_tasks.disclosure: A failing third-party column is reported to that project privately first (SECURITY.md). Until the window clears its row says 'under disclosure' with no per-check detail.

tasks.title: F17-F19: the USENIX 2026 rules the suite does not test yet (sponsor-cost bounds, re-verify at settle, execution-template allow-list)
tasks.description: Wang et al. (USENIX Security 2026) report SR5 and SR7 violations in 14 of 15 facilitators and SR8 in 9. The suite already covers parts of SR1-SR5 (F1, F2, F3, F4, F12-F14). This task adds the three rules with no check, as controls plus faulty builds offline, then verify-only runs on the owner's loopback reference. A fee-payer fixture (the payer key equal to the facilitator fee payer) is one F19 vector. Third-party columns get F17-F19 through XC-51's runner, never hosted instances.

criteria.statement: F17 (SR6): a facilitator refuses a payload whose sponsored cost exceeds a configured bound (oversized ERC-1271/6492 validation, extra accounts or signers on SVM); reference passes, faulty builds caught
F18 (SR7): /settle re-validates time-, nonce- and balance-sensitive conditions instead of trusting an earlier /verify; a proof that expires between verify and settle is refused before submission

F19 (SR8): /verify rejects any execution outside an allow-listed template: an unexpected instruction, an alternative token program or contract, an extra signer, or a fee payer that is also a transfer authority
F17-F19 run on Base Sepolia and Solana devnet against the owner's loopback reference facilitator in verify-only mode, with evidence
The USENIX crosswalk marks SR6, SR7 and SR8 as mapped
The full offline suite passes unchanged
Every changed file is inside this task's scope

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.

Testnet only: never use a mainnet CAIP-2 id, never fund a key with anything but testnet faucet tokens, never call a hosted facilitator; every facilitator under test is the owner's own instance on 127.0.0.1.
A failing third-party result is not published with per-check detail until SECURITY.md's disclosure window clears; if a criterion would need that detail to pass, STOP and report.
